items.title: One thing AI still struggles to prove isn't intelligence.
items.summary:
One thing AI still struggles to prove isn't intelligence.

A model can generate impressive results today, but without a reliable record of its past actions, it's difficult to know whether that performance is consistent or simply a single successful moment.

That's why infrastructure matters.

@RialoHQ is building toward that future with Latch Activity, where meaningful AI actions become part of a persistent, verifiable history instead of disappearing into temporary logs.

For developers and enterprises, this creates something far more valuable than isolated outputs.

It provides evidence that can be reviewed, verified, and trusted over time.

As AI becomes responsible for more important decisions, confidence won't come from impressive demonstrations alone.

It will come from transparent records that reveal how these systems have actually behaved across weeks, months, and years.

Intelligence may attract attention.

A verifiable history is what earns lasting trust.
